title: Registration
authorRules: 1 paper is covered under each registration.
In case an author has more papers than covered under their registration, additional charges will apply per extra paper (Rs. 3,000/- plus tax).
At least one author (presenting author or co-author) should be registered to have the paper to be included in the conference proceedings.
Students availing student registration must provide a valid student ID card/Bonafide certificate at the time of registration.
Papers registered under Student category (the student must be the full time student and first author) needs to be presented by Students only.
It is mandatory for everyone to register to attend the conference.
termsAndConditions: The registration fee mentioned above is EXCLUSIVE of GST @ 18%, as applicable.
You can register online using your Debit/Credit Card.
Registration is mandatory & will be only considered as confirmed on receipt of the full amount.
Accompanying person cannot attend technical sessions.
Co-authors are not considered as accompanying person.
Conference/Workshop registration fees are non-refundable and non-cancellable under any circumstances.
While your safety is of utmost importance, the organisers will take no responsibility for loss of belongings/valuables or damage to your property.
The registration fee does not include any travel cost, insurance, accommodation, sightseeing tours or airport transfers.
The decision of the General Chair is final and shall be considered conclusive for the conference matters.
inclusions: Conference kit/bag with all conference information.
Access to technical sessions & exhibition area.
Workshops and tutorials attendees must register separately.
